name: wago-plc-mcp-server
description: Read and monitor WAGO PLC parameters over the WDA REST API. The server blocks writes until you allow them.
long_description:
This extension connects Claude Desktop to WAGO PLCs (CC100, PFC100/200/300, Edge Controller, WP400, TP600) on your local network. It uses the WDA REST API over HTTPS.

**Before you start.** Make sure that this computer can reach each PLC on HTTPS port 443. To test the connection, open https://<PLC IP address> in a browser. On a company laptop, a VPN or firewall can block this connection.

**Read-only by default.** The server refuses parameter writes, method calls, and file uploads until you select *Allow writes and method calls*. The server also refuses reboot, factory reset, and firmware methods, unless you allow one exact method in *Allowed dangerous methods*.

**GitOps mode.** Select *GitOps mode* to get a YAML file for a reviewed pull request instead of a direct write.

This bundle is for one user and a few PLCs. For a shared or production fleet, use the Docker deployment: https://github.com/WagoAlex/wago-plc-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/deployment.md

plc_hosts.title: PLC IP addresses
plc_hosts.description: Required unless you select a PLC IP list file below. Use commas between the addresses. Example: 192.168.1.10,192.168.1.11.

username.title: PLC username
username.description: The WBM username on the PLCs. The server uses this username for all PLCs.

password.title: Default PLC password
password.description: The server uses this password for all PLCs, unless you set a different password below. Your operating system keychain stores this password.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes and method calls
allow_writes.description: Off: Claude can only read the PLCs. On: Claude can change parameters, run methods, and upload files. Turn this on only for PLCs that you have permission to change. All fields below this field are optional.

hosts_file.title: Many PLCs: PLC IP list file
hosts_file.description: Select a text file with one IP address on each line. A line that starts with # is a comment. The server also uses the addresses in the first field.

per_plc_passwords.title: Different passwords: IP=password pairs
per_plc_passwords.description: Use this field for a few PLCs with a different password. Use commas between the pairs, so a password in this field cannot contain a comma. Example: 192.168.1.11=secretB,192.168.1.12=secretC. The form hides this text.

passwords_file.title: Different passwords: Per-PLC passwords file
passwords_file.description: Select a text file with one IP=password pair on each line. All text after = is the password. Write each comment on its own line. This file has priority over the field above. The file is not encrypted. Windows: keep the file in your user folder, not in a synced folder such as OneDrive. Linux: set the file permission with chmod 600.

readonly_hosts.title: Safety: read-only PLCs
readonly_hosts.description: These PLCs stay read-only when 'Allow writes and method calls' is on. Use commas between the IP addresses.

allow_methods.title: Safety: allowed dangerous methods
allow_methods.description: The server refuses reboot, restart, factory reset, firmware, format, and 0-0-update-* methods. Enter exact method IDs to allow them in live mode. Use commas between the IDs. Example: 0-0-reboot-beginreboot. This field has no effect in GitOps mode.

gitops_mode.title: GitOps mode (propose changes for review)
gitops_mode.description: On: the server does not write to the PLCs. Parameter writes and method calls return a YAML file for a pull request. A person reviews the pull request, and CI applies it. This setting has an effect only when 'Allow writes and method calls' is on.

gitops_repo.title: GitOps config repository
gitops_repo.description: The name of the repository that receives the YAML files. The server shows this name in the next step of each YAML file. Leave blank to use wago-plc-config.

tls_ca.title: Security: verify PLC TLS certificates
tls_ca.description: Blank: the server does not verify PLC certificates. true: the server uses the system trust store. A full file path: the server uses this CA bundle. Windows example: C:\certs\plc-ca.pem. Linux example: /etc/ssl/certs/plc-ca.pem.

security_profile.title: Security: profile
security_profile.description: Enter hardened to stop the server at startup if PLC certificate verification is off. Leave blank for the default.

audit_log_file.title: Logs: audit log file
audit_log_file.description: The server records each write, method call, and refusal in this file. Do not leave this field blank: a blank value disables the local audit log. ~ is your user folder on Windows and Linux. Windows example: C:\Users\name\.wago-plc-mcp\audit.log. Linux example: /home/name/.wago-plc-mcp/audit.log.

log_level.title: Logs: detail level
log_level.description: Enter DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR. WARNING shows only important messages. Use DEBUG to find a connection problem.

log_file.title: Logs: debug log file
log_file.description: Leave blank to log only to the Claude Desktop log. ~ is your user folder on Windows and Linux. Example: ~/.wago-plc-mcp/debug.log.

audit_syslog.title: Logs: audit records to syslog
audit_syslog.description: The server also sends each audit record to this syslog server. Example: udp://10.0.0.5:514 or tcp://10.0.0.5:514. Leave blank to use only the local file.

syslog_host.title: Logs: SIEM syslog host
syslog_host.description: The host name or IP address of a SIEM that receives the audit records. The server then keeps 2 local audit files instead of 5. Most setups need only one of the two syslog destinations.

syslog_port.title: Logs: SIEM syslog port
syslog_port.description: The server uses this port only when 'Logs: SIEM syslog host' has a value.

syslog_tcp.title: Logs: SIEM syslog over TCP
syslog_tcp.description: On: the server sends to the SIEM syslog host over TCP. Off: the server uses UDP.

timeout_seconds.title: Tuning: request timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: The CC100 PLC needs 45 seconds or more. Other PLCs work with 15 seconds.

page_limit.title: Tuning: bulk-read page size
page_limit.description: The number of parameters on each page when the server reads a full parameter list. The WDA API returns a maximum of 255 on each page.

max_concurrent_registrations.title: Tuning: parallel PLC startup limit
max_concurrent_registrations.description: The number of PLCs that register at the same time when the server starts. Lower this number if a slow network causes registration timeouts.

max_concurrent_reads.title: Tuning: parallel read limit
max_concurrent_reads.description: The number of PLCs that the server queries at the same time during one bulk-read call.
